verdict.rationale: Calendly's own docs describe AI-generated meeting recaps and action items, plus an AI assistant with an 'Ask Callie interactive chat' (Beta). That is AI output from the user's meeting data inside the product, but the evidence is limited to thin pricing and marketing lines. Missing for 10: AI insights or suggestions drawn from broader scheduling or booking data, detailed documentation of what Callie chat can analyze or suggest, non-beta status, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Get meeting recaps and action items, plus an AI assistant to help with the work around meetings.
Callie Beta: An AI assistant that schedules over email; Ask Callie interactive chat
Finish the day knowing every meeting was captured, next steps were tracked, and follow-ups were handled.
